title: Hook Logging Format Update
prompt: All hooks should log all information to `./semio-repo/📜/{{YY}}{{MM}}{{DD}}{{HH}}{{MM}}{{SS}}_{{client}}_{{hook-kind}}.json` e.g. `./semio-repo/📜/260218230207_vscode-chat_agent-started.json`. Currently the logHook function creates filenames like `YYMMDDHHMMSS_event-name.json` but it should include the client name and use hook-kind instead of event name.
summary: Updated hook logging format to include client name in filename. Changed from `YYMMDDHHMMSS_event-name.json` to `YYMMDDHHMMSS_client_hook-kind.json` format. Updated logHook function and corresponding test. All hook tests pass.
